sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: Retrieval by distance between numeric representations.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: It looks for nearby meanings rather than requiring the exact same words.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A question and a document passage can be compared after compatible embeddings are produced.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: The vector index is inside Neo4j; it is not a second external vector database.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: It provides an additional retrieval signal when lexical overlap is weak.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Index support does not imply active provider population or proven retrieval quality. Model compatibility and current authorization still matter.
